purpose: Independent action/retrieval evaluation; not a release-level TV-editing benchmark
terms: Publicly available for non-commercial use; do not redistribute videos or put them in release artifacts
reference: Schuldt, Laptev and Caputo, Recognizing Human Actions: A Local SVM Approach, ICPR 2004
invariants: Freeze this subject partition before observing baseline scores
Never tune thresholds or fit calibration on the holdout subjects
Preserve published temporal subsequence boundaries and source hashes
Treat missing detections and unknown classification as outcomes, not excluded examples
Evaluate action discrimination separately from identity gates and full application retrieval
Use the same extracted observations for baseline and modified matcher/classifier comparisons
Report KTH's low-resolution static-camera limits; it does not validate camera-motion or TV-editing precision
